newsitem.title: USA: U.S. adj retail sales up 0.3 pct 2 wks Jan - Redbook.
newsitem.headline: U.S. adj retail sales up 0.3 pct 2 wks Jan - Redbook.

text.p: U.S. seasonally adjusted retail sales rose 0.3 percent in the first two weeks of fiscal January versus December, according to the Lynch, Jones & Ryan Inc Redbook Retail Sales Index.

The index rose 5.9 percent compared to the same month a year ago, the report said. Adjusted retail sales advanced 5.6 percent in the week ended January 18 compared with the same week a year ago, it said.
